Maintain governance workflows that support validation, approval, documentation, and audit trails for voluntary and regulatory disclosures. Support structured workflows and controls in the collection tooling and ensure the ecosystem is audit-ready. Assess feasibility of new requests and coordinate implementation across stakeholders during planning, execution/monitoring, and fulfillment phases. Support new metric development and metric changes by coordinating analysis, build, testing, and production promotion activities, including UAT and documentation sign-offs. Drive calculation/documentation revisions in partnership with SMEs, ensuring understanding of historical logic and formal sign-off of calculated values. Lead root-cause analysis for metric discrepancies identified by SMEs/auditors; recommend solutions and coordinate resolution across preparers/approvers/technical teams. Perform post-publication reconciliations between ESG Hub stored values and published values, ensuring every discrepancy is resolved to protect reliability and audit validity. Track issues to closure and ensure proper documentation of resolution outcomes. Manage access and governance administration across tooling, including maintaining relevant lists and approving access requests through established channels. Maintain key governance artifacts such as metric ownership, dataset metadata ownership, and operational permission lists. Oversee dashboard health and maintenance; report issues, track status, and support corrective actions as needed. Help design technical details of new reports (as requested) and support integration of new reporting outputs into the established ecosystem Required Qualifications Advanced experience in ESG data validation and governance, sustainability reporting, or enterprise data management. Comfort working with SQL databases and analytics environments (including authenticated enterprise access patterns). Proven experience with Agile methodology and strong working knowledge of UAT, release validation, and change control within. Demonstrated ability to manage end-to-end operational processes with multiple stakeholders (business owners, SMEs, auditors, IT/EDS teams). Experience maintaining documentation, audit trails, and governance artifacts (ownership lists, metric definitions, dataset metadata). Ability to translate business reporting requirements into technical requirements and coordinate delivery across teams. Strong communication and issue-triage skills to drive timely resolution of discrepancies and integration incidents. Core Competencies (Expert Level) ESG Data Governance: Ability to design and enforce governance frameworks that ensure consistent, reliable ESG data. Systems & Integration Management: Expertise in managing ESG data flows across interconnected systems with formal testing and approval processes. Risk & Control Mindset: Strong focus on data integrity, change control, and audit‑ready operations. Stakeholder Enablement: Ability to support sustainability reporting teams by providing trusted, well‑governed ESG data. Education & Experience Recommended Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, or a related field. Cross-Org Skills Effective Communication Results Orientation Learning Agility Digital Fluency Customer Centricity Impact & Scope Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.
